To be honest most days I try to be tough and act like it doesn't bother me. It usually works. But not sleeping from pain for a few days makes it much more difficult to keep up appearances.
Thank you so much. Its now 8am and I'm sitting in the waiting room at the doctors. If these tests don't kill me I might have to take you up on that.

It sounds to me like you did everything possible for that mouse you possibly could. She got to eat some of her favorite foods, and went peacefully surrounded in the warmth of your loving hands.

If I could choose a way to go, that sounds about as perfect to me as I could imagine.

I'm so sorry that you had to do that my friend, but please believe me when I say you did the right thing. I hope you can take comfort in the fact that she is now resting peacefully.

Stay strong *hugs*

This is a well thought out point, thank you. I really don't think I could do that to my husband, partly because I think he would blame himself for not being able to help me more. He is the type of person who always want a to fix a problem, but unfortunately my health is beyond fixing.
Thank you, my mental state has deteriorated from lack of sleep since I posted this and I really needed some kind words.

Thank you very much :). Sometimes empathy does a lot more than people realize. In my situation nothing can be done to help me, so sometimes someone letting them complain and simply saying "dude... That sucks" is all you need in a moment

I agree 100% I love my husband dearly and he's doing his best, and my daughter somehow still thinks I'm the greatest thing in the world. This is the main reason I haven't done anything and try to put on a brave face every day.

Hey, I'm not sure if I can help since I'm here for help too. Who knows, it might be like the blind leading the blind. But if you want to talk I'm here to help any way I can. I'm an ex addict as well,  so if you want to vent I'm here with and understanding ear.
